evidence_events.notes: Held-out counterfactual-robustness screen. SELECT nouns/templates are disjoint from FIT, and each donor comes from a different noun group while preserving the target subject-number direction and attractor plurality. Matched-noun and cross-noun mean recoveries differ by only 0.00166 for head 11.3. The direct v1 and incomplete-publication v2 files are noncanonical; this event uses the managed v3 ledger receipt. No unrelated endpoint control was run, so this is not selectivity.
